name: DWH Symbol Projection
rules: a symbol identifies an explicitly contracted semantic projection
a symbol does not identify a physical file or database table
consumers must not depend on storage implementation details
projection result shape is defined by the symbol profile
identical canonical state and projection definition produce semantically identical output
serialization format does not become semantic authority
a projection may describe site hierarchy, content, projectors, actions, MetaModule catalog/coverage or another explicitly contracted view
projection consumption does not transfer canonical ownership to the consumer
symbol identity is case-sensitive unless a specific symbol profile defines normalization

consumerBoundary.rule: consumers address semantic symbols and never DWH storage tables, implementation classes or physical persistence layout
